 This application coming on for admission this day, the co  following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.363/2023 dated 7.7.2023 registered at Police Station - Patharia,
District - Damoh (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 306, 498A r/w 34 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 14.11.2023.
2.
As per prosecution story on 15.6.2023 deceased Droupadi @ Trupti Tiwari committed suicide by hanging herself in matrimonial home.
Her marriage was solemnized with Kapil Tiwari, seven years ago and deceased was blessed with two sons.
It is alleged that husband of the deceased is in habit of consuming cannabis and was not providing food to the deceased and her children.
It is further alleged that father-in-law, uncle-in-law and brother-in-law were also abusing and harassing her due to which she committed suicide.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
He is admitted in hospital as he is suffering from low hemoglobin level.
It is further submitted that his marriage was performed with the deceased almost eight years ago.
They were blessed with two sons and in this period deceased never made any complaint against him.
He never instigated or abetted the deceased to commit suicide.
After investigation, charge sheet has already been filed.
Trial of the case will take time.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the State has opposed grant of bail.
5. I have gone through the statements of witnesses.

Without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case but having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pretrial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed applicant - Kapil Tiwari be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) each with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
